The source IP 10.0.5.14 was misidentified in initial logs; true source is 10.0.5.42 (WS-FIN-042), a high-criticality finance workstation. Response actions were incorrectly targeted due to IP misattribution, highlighting detection and response logic flaws.

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dynamic_DNS {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beaconing via dynamic DNS patterns"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1071/001/"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $beacon_get = "GET /news.php?cid=" wide ascii
        $beacon_post = "POST /admin/gate.php" wide ascii
        $junk_chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789" wide ascii
    condition:
        ($beacon_get or $beacon_post) and #junk_chars > 5
}
